source.note: simulation only: demand is a seeded model, not calibrated to Toronto counts (docs/TORONTO_DEMAND_STRATEGY.md)

fixed_time.title: Fixed-time
fixed_time.detail: The pre-timed signal plans; ignores traffic.

queue_responsive.title: FlowState rules
queue_responsive.detail: Queue-responsive green durations on the fixed plans (gap-out, switch on demand, extend) plus ambulance green priority. Hand-written rules, no model.

safe_heuristic.title: Safe rule reference
safe_heuristic.detail: The same queue rule evaluated per approach under the ML safety contract. No trained model; included to separate the safety contract from the model.

ml_forecast.title: Forecast-assisted rules
ml_forecast.detail: The queue rule with a trained 30 s queue forecast (bounded demand shift, predicted spillback).

rl_ppo.title: Learned policy (PPO)
rl_ppo.detail: One shared network picks hold / end / extend for every signal every 5 s, restricted to safe timings.

safety.note: amber, all-red, pedestrian clearance and protected-left phases always run their programmed length

scenarios.title: Construction
scenarios.description: Lane or full closure with work zone.

scenarios.title: Stadium Event
scenarios.description: Arrival or departure surge. Never used for training or tuning (held out).
